welcome.title:
Type Latin,
get Cyrillic
welcome.subtitle: In every app. Offline. Instantly.
welcome.credit: A continuation of Buuz by Odbayar Nyamtseren · open source
privacy.title: What you type stays yours
privacy.subtitle: Buuz runs on your computer only.
privacy.card.offline.title: 📴 Works offline
privacy.card.noLogging.title: 🙈 No keystroke logs
privacy.card.noLogging.body: Buuz does not record or send what you type
privacy.card.noAccount.title: 👤 No account
privacy.card.noAccount.body: No sign-in, no email, no password
privacy.card.passwords.title: 🔐 Off in password fields
privacy.card.passwords.body: Buuz does not touch password fields
enable.title: Add Buuz to your keyboards
enable.subtitle: Click once. Then type in every app.
enable.status.name: Buuz · Mongolian
enable.note: macOS can ask you to confirm. Click «OK».
enable.manual.title: or do it yourself
enable.manual.path: System Settings › Keyboard › Input Sources › Edit… › ＋ › Mongolian › Buuz
enable.error: Buuz could not add itself. Add it yourself with the steps below.
shortcut.title: Pick your switch key
shortcut.subtitle: Mongolian ⇄ Latin with one key
shortcut.fn.title: 🌐 fn (Globe key)
shortcut.controlSpace.title: ⌃ Control + Space
shortcut.capsLock.title: ⇪ Caps Lock
shortcut.manual.note: You turn on this key in the macOS settings.
try.title: Give it a try
try.subtitle: Type in Latin. Buuz changes it as you type.
try.chat.name: Mom
try.trap: Got унуудур? The next step shows the trick 😉
tip.title: 💡 One small trick
tip.subtitle: o and u change to match the word.
tip.harmony.title: 🪄 Vowels match the word
tip.harmony.body: When the word has э, ө or ү: o → ө, u → ү
tip.force.title: 🎯 Need ө or ү for sure?
tip.force.body: At the start of a word, or at any time
tip.force.keys: q → ө · w → ү · ' → ь · " → ъ
done.title: You are ready! 🎉
done.subtitle: Find Buuz as «Б» in the menu bar.
done.recap.title: Remember
settings.home.statusOff: ⚠️ Buuz is not in your keyboards
settings.home.noStats: We do not count keystrokes. So there are no statistics here.
settings.typing.title: Typing
settings.typing.smartVowels.hint: o → о/ө, u → у/ү to match the word
settings.typing.autoCapitals.hint: Starts each sentence with a capital letter
settings.typing.customKeys.hint: v → ү, zh → ж and more
settings.typing.underline.hint: Underlines the word that you type
settings.shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
settings.shortcuts.switchKey.hint: macOS controls this key. Buuz sets it when you select one.
settings.transfer.title: Import & export
settings.transfer.hint: Copy your settings and use them on another device or on the web.
settings.privacy.title: Privacy
settings.privacy.noNetwork: Buuz makes no network calls while you type.
settings.privacy.updates.hint: This is the only network use. It only asks if there is a new version. It never sends what you type.
settings.general.title: General
settings.general.updateError: Could not check. Try again later.
settings.feedback.title: Feedback
settings.feedback.body: Found a bug, or have an idea? Tell us.
settings.about.title: About
settings.about.credit: Buuz 2.0 continues Buuz by Odbayar Nyamtseren.
settings.about.licenseCore: Typing rules from the original Buuz · Apache-2.0
